notes: PRINTED-APPENDIX SPECIFICATION (Nov 4, 2026): outside the main-text sample (PROTOCOL 5b ruling (r)); for the appendix-inclusive sensitivity analysis. General Access design (gvar first_treat_time), border-county subsample of Appendix Table C.5 column (1): code.R lines 953-956, generate_results('first_treat_time', general_reg_data[general_access_border_counties == T]). Only the county sample changes (the authors' flag general_access_border_counties, constant within county); no border-pair fixed effects or pair-specific time effects are added. Sample: 1,098 counties, quarters 1-30, 32,940 rows, balanced; 13 adoption cohorts (quarters 10,11,12,15,16,17,18,20,21,23,24,27,29); 394 never-treated counties (35.9% of rows); no always-treated counties; largest county weight share 5.6%. Authors report Callaway-Sant'Anna with the main-text settings (code.R generate_results(), lines 277-364: did::att_gt, control_group = 'notyettreated', est_method = 'dr', base_period = 'varying', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, xformla = ~1, weightsname = 'num_individs_2015', clustervars = county, bstrap = TRUE without a seed; aggte(type = 'simple' or 'dynamic', min_e = -8, max_e = 16)). No TWFE regression exists in the package; the TWFE counterpart is D = 1[gvar > 0 & time >= gvar] with county FE + quarter FE, weights num_individs_2015, clustered by county. Treatment never switches off (defined from a unit-constant timing variable). Outcome levels were additively transformed by the authors to hide actual levels (README); county IDs anonymized; underlying UC Consumer Credit Panel is restricted. Project member Davide Proserpio is a coauthor (PROTOCOL Section 6). y_sd_* are computed on the non-missing rows of the sample before drop_e_above, as in the main-text template.
